name: Amadeus
source:
Amadeus is a mysterious figure who emerged to lead the proletariat in their fight for liberty. He is a leader, a big brother, and, above all, a savior. Under his leadership, the proletariat can finally rise. With his wisdom, the revolution is at hand. But if he is to save the people, he must first regain something that, unbeknownst to him, he has lost.

[spoiler]His true identity is Franz Byron, who grew up into a bitter and cynical revolutionary after the Maison de Bouvoire incident.[/spoiler]
